debate_summary: Creative editor A protects the zodiac doorway but rejects pure zodiac quote-card treatment.
Creative editor B protects visible object movement: keys pull him up, phone books, checklist changes, road-pointing changes direction.
Writer A keeps the creator-supplied copy exact because the rhythm is already public and taggable.
Writer B repairs the risk by ensuring every slide gives Zuv an active choice: he plans, listens, fixes, follows, watches, closes the notebook.
